label: Wat Pa Mueat

scripts.label: Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา

materials.label: Mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา

samples: Suep cata khao, Suep cata ban mueang lae ho hoen, Ubat hom, Kam sut thon pa ca,

lede: Wat Pa Mueat accounts for 76 catalogued manuscripts, 38 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (99% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Pua District. Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (70%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (30%). Dated witnesses run 1797–1950 CE (15 of 76 carry a date).

findings.title: The temples of practical magic
findings.gloss: 3 temples whose catalogued holdings lean unusually hard toward magic-ritual texts — well above the corpus norm.
